fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Nine years in regional Western Australia, where referring a patient meant sending them a very long way, meant learning to do work a metropolitan general practice would routinely pass on. For a Port Fairy patient the arithmetic is simple: twenty-five minutes to Warrnambool compares favourably with three hours to Melbourne. She will also tell you when a case genuinely warrants a specialist.

fields.label: Fine print
fields.value: Dr Meg is a general dentist, not a registered specialist in implant dentistry, endodontics or oral surgery.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Ready to book? Give us a call on {{phone}}. We would be glad to see you.

fields.label: Small heading
fields.value: Getting to us

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Driving — leave Port Fairy on the Princes Highway heading east and stay on it through Illowa and Dennington. It becomes Raglan Parade approaching Warrnambool; turn into the city centre and find Lava Street, one block north of Koroit Street, near the Coles at number 130. About twenty-five minutes door to door.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Bus — coach and bus services run several times daily and arrive at the Lava Street Interchange, on our street. Check current services with Public Transport Victoria.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Parking — the Warrnambool Shopping Centre car park is nearest, entered from Lava Street or Koroit Street. Ozone, Parkers and the Coles–Younger car parks are within a short walk, and Banyan Street generally has free on-street parking within the signed limits. Street parking near the practice is paid, and the shopping centre car park is free for two hours.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Common questions

fields.label: Button words
fields.value: Can treatment be grouped so I am not driving in every week?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Where it is clinically sensible, yes. Some stages have to be separated by healing time, but we will plan around the drive where we can.

fields.label: Button words
fields.value: Should I arrange a lift for an extraction or implant?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: For anything surgical, it is a good idea. Twenty-five minutes of highway is easier as a passenger.

fields.label: Button words
fields.value: Do you offer implants, or would I be referred?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Dr Meg places and restores implants herself, for suitable single and multiple cases. All-on-4 is not offered. Suitability is confirmed after examination and 3D imaging.

fields.label: Button words
fields.value: What if I have a dental emergency at the Port Fairy end?

fields.label: Words
fields.value: From opening in December 2026, we will hold two same-day emergency appointments each day. Call

fields.label: Words
fields.value: first thing in the morning to secure one. Emergency appointments cannot be booked online.

fields.label: Words
fields.value: We hold two same-day emergency appointments each day. Call

fields.label: Words

fields.label: Words
fields.value: After hours, go to the Emergency Department. If it is a serious facial injury, uncontrolled bleeding, or swelling affecting your breathing or swallowing, go to South West Healthcare or call 000 rather than driving to a dental practice.
